value.rationale: Planar projective second-moment designs are natural isotropic direction samplers, with triangle random pair updates an explicit minimal particle instance. Calibrated Gaussian noise matches every second moment yet necessarily leaves a universal positive fourth-cumulant defect. The exact monotone Pareto curve shows the fastest synchronous contraction has the largest such defect; the unit-target example increases the radial energy variance from 4 to 28/5. This is a structural sampler diagnostic across all admissible designs, not a routine recalculation of one arbitrary parameter.
